summary: Two-Step Leave Approval Flow tested successfully. Backend: 9/9 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features verified - Reporting Manager dropdown, Approvals tab visibility, and approval status indicators working correctly. Fixed a SelectItem empty value bug in EmployeeProfile.js and EmployeeDirectory.js.
passed_tests: Backend: Employee has reporting_manager_id set correctly (Rudra → Rajiv)
Backend: POST /api/leave/apply sets dept_head_id from employee's reporting_manager_id
Backend: GET /api/leave/pending-approvals returns leaves for managers with reportees
Backend: PUT /api/leave/{leave_id}/approve - Manager approval sets dept_head_status=approved, keeps status=pending
Backend: PUT /api/leave/{leave_id}/approve - HR approval after manager sets final status=approved
Backend: PUT /api/leave/{leave_id}/reject - Manager can reject leave request
Backend: HR can approve directly (bypass manager if needed)
Backend: GET /api/leave/my-requests includes dept_head_status and hr_status fields
Backend: Manager pending-approvals endpoint accessible to users with reportees
Frontend: Employee Profile edit form shows Reporting Manager dropdown
Frontend: Reporting Manager dropdown is clickable and lists all employees
Frontend: Selected Reporting Manager (Rajiv Ranjan) displays correctly
Frontend: Leave page shows 'Pending Approvals' tab for managers
Frontend: Pending Approvals tab shows badge with count of pending requests
Frontend: Leave requests show 'Manager: pending/approved' and 'HR: pending/approved' status indicators
critical_code_review_comments: Two-step approval flow implemented correctly: apply_leave → manager approves (dept_head_status=approved) → HR approves (final status=approved)
pending-approvals endpoint correctly filters by reporting_manager_id to show leaves from reportees
Status indicators (Manager/HR) correctly shown in LeavePage.js for leaves with two-step approval
Approvals tab dynamically appears based on hasApprovals state (not just manager role)
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test leaves with reason prefix TEST_ for testing the two-step approval flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two-step leave approval flow is fully functional. Flow: Employee applies → Manager sees in pending-approvals → Manager approves (dept_head_status=approved, status stays pending) → HR sees → HR approves (final status=approved). The Reporting Manager dropdown is fixed in both EmployeeProfile.js and EmployeeDirectory.js (was using empty string value which Radix UI Select doesn't allow). Leave status indicators show 'Manager: pending/approved' and 'HR: pending/approved' badges on leave requests.

apply_leave_sets_dept_head_id.description: POST /api/leave/apply sets dept_head_id from employee's reporting_manager_id, with fallback to department head_employee_id

pending_approvals_for_managers.description: GET /api/leave/pending-approvals returns leaves where user is the reporting manager of applicant

two_step_approval.description: Manager approval sets dept_head_status=approved but keeps overall status=pending. HR approval sets final status=approved.

manager_rejection.description: Managers can reject leave requests for their reportees

reporting_manager_dropdown.description: Employee Profile edit form shows Reporting Manager dropdown with list of all active employees

approvals_tab_visibility.description: Approvals tab appears for any user with pending approvals (based on hasApprovals state), not just manager role

approval_status_indicators.description: Leave requests display 'Manager: pending/approved' and 'HR: pending/approved' status badges
